attribution: GTA VI Landmarks Data (CC BY 4.0) — https://map.gtadb.org; gtadb.org and all contributors.
changes: None; the original downloaded JSON bytes are preserved.
limitations: Record count is not a count of Rockstar-confirmed POIs.
Locations, names, real-world matches and tags can be conjectural.
Some source material may derive from development leaks.
The dataset uses positional arrays; read upstream code before normalizing.
Game coordinates are not real-world latitude/longitude.
No exhaustive record-by-record audit was performed.
Do not infer access to game runtime or routing accuracy.
upstream_requested_update_method: Git pull or sparse checkout from the source repository, rather than fetching live data/media from gtadb.org.
